issues.title: Your text is too hard to read
issues.desc: Text and background colors do not have enough contrast for people with low vision.

issues.title: Images missing descriptions
issues.desc: Images have no alt text, making them invisible to screen readers and users who cannot see them.

issues.title: Your forms confuse blind visitors
issues.desc: Buttons have no label, so screen readers cannot tell users what the button does.

issues.title: Maps and widgets are invisible
issues.desc: Embedded iframes have no title attribute, so their contents are completely hidden from screen readers.
